name: Search API Sorts Widget
description: Form widget for the Search API Sorts module.
project_description:
Provides a select/dropdown form-based widget for Search API Sorts .

 Features 

 
 Separate labels for ascending and descending values. 
 Show only ascending, or descending, or both (D7 only). 
 Autosubmit (require ctools for D7) 
 
 Setup 

 
 Go to the search index page: admin/config/search/search_api/index/[SEARCH_INDEX] 
 Enable the required sorts on the "Sorts" tab. 
 Switch to the "Sorts widget" tab. 
 Select "Use form widget" ("Active" for D8). 
 Optionally configure auto-submit functionality. 
 Provide labels for the ascending and descending values of each sort field. 
 Choose directions to display in the "Orders" column (D7 only). 
 Save settings.
